deposits.genre_observed: pre-registration of wave 2 of the flattening panel, with six numbered predictions and falsifiers

finds.quote:
## What will be run

The same thirteen items at the same address forms, on Google AI Overview, signed out, in one session, at a cadence of one wave per calendar month, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days). Twelve Google addresses from wave 1 plus the two archive-adjacent taxonomy addresses already in the panel. Qwen 3.7 is carried as a second-surface arm on the two items that have one (P-TAX-SAPPHO-147-31, and P-COIN-PER if the address renders a composition there).
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: the wave-2 run plan, fixed before the run: same thirteen items, same address forms, monthly cadence, Qwen 3.7 second-surface arm.

finds.quote: 1. **DS is stable at the dictionary items.** P-DICT-BANK stays at 1 of 3 at both forms; P-DICT-CRANE stays at 3 of 3; P-DICT-MERCURY stays at 2 of 3.
finds.falsifier_quote: Falsified by a change of ±1 distinction at any of the three.
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: pre-registered prediction 1 for wave 2 with its falsifier.

finds.quote: 2. **The tied/untied asymmetry persists at the archive-adjacent items** (P-TAX-OPERATIVE-OPERATIONAL, P-ARCH-OMEGA, P-CAT-PEARL, P-COIN-PER) and does not appear at the world items.
finds.falsifier_quote: Falsified if a world item's entity-tied arm gains distinctions its untied arm lacks, or if an archive-adjacent item's arms converge.
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: pre-registered prediction 2 (tied/untied asymmetry) with falsifier.

finds.quote: 3. **R_new does not fall.** The three dated coinages continue to be reached as their own kind at their own addresses.
finds.falsifier_quote: Falsified by any of the three dropping to its conflation target.
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: pre-registered prediction 3 with falsifier.

finds.quote: 4. **The stratum means do not separate.** World strata and archive-adjacent strata remain within 0.10 of each other on mean share of inventory reached.
finds.falsifier_quote: Falsified by a gap wider than 0.10 in either direction — and a gap in the *archive's* favour falsifies it as surely as one against.
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: pre-registered prediction 4 (stratum means within 0.10) with two-sided falsifier.

finds.quote: 5. **Write-back exceeds recovery.** Compositions found as presented sources at a later observation outnumber distinctions that return after a loss.
finds.falsifier_quote: Falsified by recovery ≥ write-back over the panel.
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: pre-registered prediction 5 with falsifier.

finds.quote: 6. **The Sappho operator does not route through fragment 31 at the naked address**, and continues to organize adjacent canonical material.
finds.falsifier_quote: Falsified by the derivation appearing at the naked address, or by the operator vanishing from it.
finds.window: wave 2, beginning 2026-10-15 (±3 days), one wave per calendar month
finds.note: pre-registered prediction 6 (Sappho operator at the naked address) with falsifier.

finds.quote:
## The measurement that needs two waves

The divergence signature — ΔH_head ≥ 0 while ΔD_world < 0 — cannot be read from one wave. Wave 2 supplies the first ΔD_world on a world panel. The head instruments are recorded in the panel from published series on the same surface over the same period and are not measured by this instrument.
finds.note: the divergence-signature measurement, specified and needing two waves; first readable after wave 2.

finds.quote:
## What would end the programme

If wave 2 shows the world items gaining distinctions while the archive items hold, the flattening reading of EA-FLAT-01 fails and the notebook is superseded rather than revised. If the stratum means separate in the archive's favour, the porosity reading of EA-PORE-01 needs the same treatment. Both outcomes are recorded and deposited regardless of sign.
finds.note: programme-level falsification condition for the flattening reading of EA-FLAT-01 and the porosity reading of EA-PORE-01; stated as what would supersede the notebooks, outcomes deposited regardless of sign.

finds.quote: A blind pass by a coder who has not seen the conflation targets is worth more and remains open.
